paste_notes: This team does its best to utilize the Doom Desire Jirachi to pressure the most common status absorbers, Blissey, Swampert, and Starmie, with its combination of Doom Desire, Thunder, and HP Grass. Blissey supports the paraspam and is a fantastic special wall vs things Jirachi can't handle, and Restzap frees up Blissey's moveslots. Wish on Jirachi supports all of Zapdos, Claydol, and BKCTar to do their jobs better, and BKCTar is the primary beneficiary of the paraspam. Spikes is good for pressuring the common status absorbers and makes many attacks 2hkos and preserve the high bulk on the team. Celebi is a slight problem, but Roar + Sleep Talk Zapdos, Drill Peck Skarmory, and Flame + Ice on Blissey make the matchup winnable especially with how good the matchup is into many common celebi cores (such as Unemployed 6 or Aerobi) where they struggle with some combination of Jirachi, BKCTar, and RestZap.

paste_notes:
Gen 3 OU
Fun squad built around endgame Scizor. 
Breloom lures and chips fliers for Scizor. It also provides early game momentum and a soft check to DD Tar.
Metagross provides a Rock resist and solid switchin to Aerodactyl. 
Snorlax provides the team with an interim measure against special attackers like Starmie.
Tyranitar traps Gengar to help Breloom, Gyarados and Scizor to sweep. It also helps in the Moltres matchup.
Jolly HP Rock Gyarados provides a nice Aerodactyl and Jolteon lure.
The team is a bit flaws, but pretty fun to use.

thread_title: ADV OU Creative Sets, Synergistic Cores, and Concepts

paste_notes:
Was making sets and thought of doing Download (Forgot Download was gen 4+) But decided that I liked the idea of offensive Porgyon 2. So I made this team around it. An Offensive Team, with Porgyon 2 nice for Dug as well. Since this team can struggle with dug.

Ttar lead cause Mix Ttar is really awesome and I like using it. Don't like too many other Ttar sets too much but this set is really good.

Porgyon 2 of course, special attacking Hp Grass for Pert since that can really be a sturggle for this team. With Max Special Attack it is cleaving a hole and its 105SPA is not even that bad. Ice Beam and Thunderbolt both hit extra hard and recover to you know recover and take advantage of porgyon 2 nice natural bulk.

Salamance is a endgamer sweeper, DD set I didn't like DD before this team but now I actually enjoy it a lot more. With this team around it I feel like I can save it most of the time then +1 on something force something out. Sometimes though this does kinda become a mid game wall breaker for Aero.

Speaking of Aero, don't like Choice Band that much. Its strong and fast but I get to pick one move. In some matches I do wish I had band however, I'd rather have the ability to flip movesets around whenever it is needed. Hp Bug for Celbi over Hp Flying, though this does make Breloom and fighters kinda scary. So its a pick your poison.

Dugtrio, Admant for the power boost. I wanna be able to cleave things. 339 speed still outspeeds most targets. note, most. This team really hates Starmie so if you wanna just make sure starmie does down after you sac something to it, Jolly instead. 


Metagross as another wallbreaker, Explosion is scary for everything. This was offensivly one of the weaker mons for the team but it also provides a backbone and can soak usually at least one physically hit then boom or kill with mash or something. Like a +1 Mence or something. So it and Porgyon 2 kinda serve as the semi tanky mons just in case I need to switch them into something deadly, they don't get folded usually be any one single move.

Lead with Ttar, make switches and find opening, break them open with Metagross, Salamance, Aerodactyl or Porgyon 2. Use Dug when you get the chance to trap. Save Aero or Salamance for the end game to sweep. That is the simple game plan.
